module: D10-09 上游與下游不對稱傳導

routeAnchor.issuerEvidence: Official issuer sustainability disclosure identifies EAF steelmaking with scrap as 98% of 2025 main raw material.
routeAnchor.economicUse: Route relevance only; monitoring-platform benchmarks are not assumed to equal issuer realized procurement/sales prices.

sources.monitoringPlatform: 我國基本金屬供需情勢發展監控平台
sources.sourceClockRule: Use capturedAt conservatively for prospective replay unless native publication timestamp is separately frozen.

asymmetricTransmissionWitnesses: 2026-08: upstream scrap rose while billet fell and H-beam stayed flat.
2026-09: upstream scrap and billet both rose while H-beam stayed flat.
The direction of an upstream price move therefore does not mechanically determine contemporaneous downstream posted/market price direction.
Intermediate and downstream layers can respond differently to the same broad input-cost environment.
forbiddenInferences: Do not call the flat H-beam benchmark a realized issuer ASP.
Do not infer a margin squeeze from scrap-up/H-beam-flat without inventory, electricity, yield, freight, mix and contract-lag evidence.
Do not subtract NTD/kg scrap from NTD/t H-beam to create a synthetic company margin.
Do not assume billet is an internal transfer price for 2006 or that all H-beam output shares the same input vintage.
Do not assign bullish/bearish stock direction from the chain vector.
Two monthly vintages establish data semantics, not stable elasticity.

pitSemantics.sameChainClock: Each monthly layer is frozen under the same observation month; capturedAt remains the conservative research-known clock.
pitSemantics.firstEligibleDecision: Only after the monthly source is captured; never backdate to month-end.
pitSemantics.revisionRule: Later revisions append a new source vintage and do not overwrite the earlier research state.

promotionReason: Two independent monthly Taiwan chain vintages can be replayed with explicit upstream/intermediate/downstream direction states, and they already produce different transmission vectors under a common route anchor. This establishes Taiwan PIT/source feasibility for asymmetric transmission, not a pass-through coefficient, realized margin effect or predictive alpha.
exactNext: SC-037 append the next independent monthly chain vintage and preserve revision/source clocks.
SC-038 add a second industry chain with at least three layers to test whether DOWNSTREAM_STICKY is steel-specific.
Only after independent chains/dates accumulate may D10-09 enter L4 prospective/OOS effect testing.
